e.title: Reinsurance News（再保险日报）
e.summary: 全球再保险每日要闻：续转、业绩、巨灾损失、Lloyd’s、网络再保、参数化与 AI 专题
e.summary_en: Daily global reinsurance news: renewals, results, major losses, Lloyd’s, cyber reinsurance, parametric and AI topics
e.summary_hk: 全球再保險每日要聞：續轉、業績、巨災損失、Lloyd’s、網絡再保、參數化與 AI 專題
e.body: Reinsurance News（`reinsurancene.ws`）是**全球再保险业的每日要闻平台**，定位明确：「把知识管理与再保险洞察结合技术，带来重要的再保险行业新闻（网站 + 每日邮件）」。其分类体系可核实且贴合再保职能：**Monte Carlo Rendez-Vous（蒙特卡洛再保年会）**、**Reinsurance Renewals（续转）**、**Re/Insurer results（业绩）**、People Moves、**Major loss news（巨灾/大额损失）**、**Lloyd’s of London**、**Cyber reinsurance news**、**Parametric re/insurance news**、M&A、**Legacy reinsurance news（遗留业务）**、InsurTech & Technology、**Climate Resilience**、**Artificial intelligence news**，Lines of Business 侧再按 P&C Reinsurance、Marine Reinsurance 等分。对 RIAA：再保险是保险价值链的上游，也是**理解承保周期与资本供给**的关键——这份日报的价值在于它按**再保业务职能**（续转/业绩/巨灾/遗留/网络）而非按综合新闻分类，等于给出了一张「再保行业每天在关心什么」的清单；与 [[artemis]]（ILS 与巨灾债券专门口径）互为上下游（ILS 是再保资本的替代来源），与 [[reinsurance]]、[[reinsurance-networks]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 构成概念到实务的链条；AI 与网络再保专题可与 [[lma-ai-governance]]、[[catmodeling]] 对照；行业基准数据仍以 [[swiss-re-sigma]] 与 [[munich-re]] 等为准；适合作再保方向、行业跟踪与面试准备。
e.body_en: Reinsurance News (`reinsurancene.ws`) is **a daily news platform for the global reinsurance industry**, with a clear pitch: "by combining our experience in knowledge management and reinsurance insight with technology, we aim to bring you the reinsurance industry news that matters", online and by daily email. Its verifiable taxonomy maps onto reinsurance functions: **Monte Carlo Rendez-Vous**, **Reinsurance Renewals**, **Re/Insurer results**, People Moves, **Major loss news**, **Lloyd’s of London**, **Cyber reinsurance news**, **Parametric re/insurance news**, M&A, **Legacy reinsurance news**, InsurTech & Technology, **Climate Resilience** and **Artificial intelligence news**, with Lines of Business splitting further into P&C Reinsurance, Marine Reinsurance and others. For RIAA: reinsurance is upstream in the insurance value chain and key to **understanding the underwriting cycle and the supply of capital** — this daily’s value is that it organises by **reinsurance function** (renewals / results / catastrophe / legacy / cyber) rather than general news, effectively a checklist of "what the reinsurance industry cares about each day"; it sits upstream/downstream of [[artemis]] (ILS and cat bond specific — ILS being an alternative source of reinsurance capital), and with [[reinsurance]], [[reinsurance-networks]] and [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] it forms a concept-to-practice chain; the AI and cyber reinsurance strands tie to [[lma-ai-governance]] and [[catmodeling]]; benchmark industry data should still come from [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[munich-re]]; suits reinsurance specialisation, industry tracking and interview preparation.
e.body_hk: Reinsurance News（`reinsurancene.ws`）是**全球再保險業的每日要聞平台**，定位明確：「把知識管理與再保險洞察結合技術，帶來重要的再保險行業新聞（網站 + 每日郵件）」。其分類體系可核實且貼合再保職能：**Monte Carlo Rendez-Vous**、**Reinsurance Renewals**、**Re/Insurer results**、People Moves、**Major loss news**、**Lloyd’s of London**、**Cyber reinsurance news**、**Parametric re/insurance news**、M&A、**Legacy reinsurance news**、InsurTech & Technology、**Climate Resilience**、**Artificial intelligence news**。對 RIAA：再保險是保險價值鏈的上游，也是**理解承保週期與資本供給**的關鍵——這份日報按**再保業務職能**而非綜合新聞分類，等於給出一張「再保行業每天在關心什麼」的清單；與 [[artemis]]（ILS 與巨災債券專門口徑）互為上下游，與 [[reinsurance]]、[[reinsurance-networks]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 構成概念到實務的鏈條；AI 與網絡再保專題可與 [[lma-ai-governance]]、[[catmodeling]] 對照；行業基準數據仍以 [[swiss-re-sigma]] 與 [[munich-re]] 為準；適合作再保方向、行業跟蹤與面試準備。
